title: Inhalation Unit-Dose Quantity Share — Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing)
content:
**Price-list footnote.** Inhalation unit doses (code J7613 under revenue code 0637) on an observation or emergency account of the Hospital Account (Encounter Billing), valued for an Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing), are valued at their charges times their quantity share by unit doses dispensed (its billed units):

| Unit doses dispensed | Quantity share |
|---|---|
| 6 or more | 0.5 |
| 2 to 5 | 0.55 |
| a single unit dose | 1 |

Hypothetical: charges 60.00 with 5 unit doses → 33.00; with 6 → 30.00.
